title: Chapter 265 - 265 Take Good Care Of Her; Hot Discussion!
content:
Chapter 265 - 265 Take Good Care Of Her; Hot Discussion!

Chapter 265 - 265 Take Good Care of Her; Hot Discussion!

265 Take Good Care of Her; Hot Discussion!

Lin Fan led the women through the passage under the lead of Flying Dragon Security Company’s manager, Wang Shengli. They soon arrived at the stadium’s lounge.

At this moment, Ling Rou was sitting inside.

She seemed to have heard footsteps and slowly turned around.

Instantly, Ling Rou’s beautiful face appeared in everyone’s sight.

Ling Rou was very beautiful…

However, when she was on stage, she gave off a dream-like feeling as if she was in the clouds—out of reach.

Now, she had truly appeared in front of everyone.

The Star diamond dress, her jet-black hair, fair skin, and voluptuous figure… The air was faintly filled with a unique fragrance of sweat.

Even Lin Fan was stunned.

Just as Lin Fan was looking at Ling Rou, Ling Rou was also looking at Lin Fan.

At this moment, in Ling Rou’s eyes, Lin Fan was the only one standing in the lounge.

If it was not for Lin Fan, she might have stayed in the bar for two years and then given up singing.

If it was not for Lin Fan, she might not have been able to hold a concert in her lifetime, let alone receive so much applause.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s handsome face, tall figure, crisp voice, and the scene of him performing Galaxy… All of them were like scenes from a movie, gradually engraving themselves in the depths of Ling Rou’s mind.

In Ling Rou’s eyes, the entire lounge had turned dark while Lin Fan’s body emitted a dazzling light.

At this moment, Lin Fan, who was initially stunned, suddenly had a change in expression.

It was because a crisp voice had suddenly sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Charming Aura, triggered!]

Then, Lin Fan could not help but use the Eyes of Truth on Ling Rou.

[Appearance: 98]

[Favorability: 95]

As expected, Charming Aura was triggered on Ling Rou.

At this moment, Qiu Ziqian praised sincerely, “So beautiful!”

“You’re also very beautiful.”

“Sister Ling Rou, your songs are so good!” Huang Ling said.

“Thank you,” Ling Rou said.

It seemed that it was easy for beautiful women to become friends.

After a while, the women started chatting with Ling Rou and laughed from time to time.

Even the shy Xia Bing and Xia Xue also said something.

They chatted for more than half an hour.

At this moment, Hu Tian said, “Sister Ling Rou sang so many songs on stage just now. I think she’s very tired… Lin Fan, you have to take good care of her later.”

When the women heard this, they also echoed.

“Yeah, take good care of her.”

“I’ll leave Sister Ling Rou to you.”

Then, the women walked out and closed the door.

At this point…

Only Lin Fan and Ling Rou were left in the lounge. It was very quiet

The two of them sat facing each other, and they could even vaguely hear each other’s breathing.

The air… It gradually became hot and dry, causing Ling Rou’s pretty face to flush red.

Then, the two of them seemed to be attracted by something as they kept approaching… They got closer.

…

After more than an hour, the door to the lounge slowly opened.

Then, a helicopter flew over from afar and carried the two of them toward Coiling Dragon Villa.

The Coiling Dragon Villa Complex was very lively tonight. Soon, a long and special song sounded, and it did not stop for the entire night.

….

The Coiling Dragon Villa Complex was bustling with activity, and the internet was even more lively.

On Weibo.

Jun Zhi ZN: [Oh my God! The concert at Jiangbei City Stadium is definitely the best concert I’ve ever been to! It was so cool!]

Dragon God: [Isn’t that so? Not only was Ling Rou beautiful, but she also sang so well! From today onward, she’s my goddess! No! She’s a true goddess!]

Guarding the World: [I got the tickets but didn’t go. You guys are praising it so much that I’m a little regretful now.]

Shadowless: [Brother, you’ll regret it for the rest of your life. I took some videos with my phone. You’ll know when you watch it.]

Guarding the World: [F*ck, f*ck! The stage of the concert, am I seeing things? Are those ten Rolls-Royce Phantoms?! Using ten Rolls-Royce Phantoms as lights? 100 million yuan worth of lights?]

The Person Closest to God: [Brother, you’re not mistaken. Those are lights that cost 100 million! However, this is still nothing! Do you see the stage lights shining on Ling Rou? That’s the light of a MD902 helicopter! By the way, that helicopter costs 45 million yuan.]

The Person Closest to God: [Also, do you see the shiny dress on Ling Rou? Those are all diamonds! This dress is called Star and is worth more than ten million US dollars!]

Most Mysterious Person: [The sound system at the concert is much better than at other concerts. Because they used a complete set of FM Acoustics. The total cost should be more than 50 million yuan.]

Most Mysterious Person: [In addition, there were ten 100 square meters LED high-definition display screens outside the stadium. The total cost of this is also more than ten million yuan.]

As the most mysterious person concluded, more people exclaimed.

Isha Irene: [100 million on lights, 45 million on stage lights, 70 million on clothes, 50 million on the sound system, ten on million screens… That’s a total of 275 million yuan! Heavens!]

Shadowless: [Don’t just talk about money. Look at Ling Rou’s appearance and listen to her singing! That’s simply the pinnacle of looks and vocals!]

….

Soon, the concert at Jiangbei City Stadium became the top trending topic on Weibo.

Moreover, under the intentional promotion of Penguin, Little Tanuki Corporation, and Alphabet, videos and news of the event were still spreading.

At this moment, at Gundong Entertainment.

Although it was already very late, Director Zhao Peng still called for an emergency meeting with the higher-ups.

“I’m sorry to have called everyone over so late at night, but there is indeed something very important to discuss with everyone.

“I won’t say much about the gossip. You should all know that there was a concert at Jiangbei City Stadium tonight. If you don’t know, you can take a look at the trending searches on Weibo.

“I’ve checked the information about the concert’s main character, Ling Rou. She doesn’t seem to have signed a contract with any entertainment company… What I mean is that we have to use methods such as offering a sky-high offer and massive amounts of resources as well as big-name advertisements to get her to sign a contract with our company or cooperate with us as much as possible.

“Otherwise, if other companies get ahead of us, we’ll be left with endless regret.”

After hearing his words, some of the higher-ups frowned, while others lowered their heads in thought.

Finally, a bald man said hesitantly, “Ling Rou should be quite popular now. However, there were some people who were very popular in the past, but in the end, they all disappeared completely in the ocean of the internet.

“Do we need to put in so much effort to work with her?”
